Title: Kunal's Day

Cast

1. Kunal - 8 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Meenakshi - 34 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Naira - 12 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
4. Tanay - 8 years, friend
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Kunal: "Let's do something fun today."

[A dust storm sweeps across the village.]

Meenakshi: "Kunal, listen!"

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Kunal: "One more time!"

[Flower petals rain down on Kunal.]

Meenakshi: "Exactly right."

[Birds chirp in the trees.]

Kunal (happily): "And then?"

[A flock of birds flies across the sky.]

Kunal (happily): "Mom, look at this."

[Suddenly the ground shakes.]

Kunal (gently): "This is amazing!"

[Kunal lights a bonfire.]

Kunal: "What a day to remember!"
